scope.frame: no frame: the fibre's character variety (tr a, tr b, tr ab) over Q-bar and over F_p for every prime p <= 47
scope.object: the moves as the trace identity, and the readings fixed by every move, with the swap and the central sign actions carried both ways
scope.hypotheses: PF5's 'what is read takes part and reading it again returns it' formalised as a reading fixed by every move; PF1 as kappa != 2

claim_one_line: THE MATH DECIDES PF5'S LOOP (PROVED, exact; data-free): the read-out acts back by the moves' own form (L: (x, y, z) -> (x, z, xz - y), the trace identity); the readings fixed by every move are exactly the common point (0, 0, 0) and 'nothing' (2, 2, 2) over Q-bar and every F_p to 47; the swap keeps both, the sign actions only the common point; PF1 excludes kappa = 2, so the one self-consistent outcome is the common point, the symmetric point, which carries no values by itself: values can only live in the flow away from it
weave_or_thread: weave (every move acting together on the whole character variety, nothing chosen)
